name: [🚨] 911 Dispatch Simulator
desc:
Welcome to 911 Dispatch Simulator, where every call and every decision matters! Answer 911 calls, gather critical information, and dispatch Police, Fire, and EMS units to emergencies across the city.

🚨 UPDATE 8 — MERIDIAN BAY 2.0 is here! Dispatch across a brand-new city with freeways, lakes and a beach, survive DISASTERS like storms, earthquakes and heat waves, and take on 400 new calls!

📞 Answer emergency 911 calls and question callers!
🚓 Dispatch Police, Fire, and EMS units!
🗺️ Track incidents and responding units across the city!
🏙️ Unlock new districts and expand your coverage across the city!
💵 Earn Cash and XP, unlock new units, and rise through the ranks!

🎁 GROUP BONUS — Join the group for +20% Cash & XP!
⭐ ROBLOX PLUS — Plus members receive an additional +20% Cash & XP! Bonuses stack!

⚠️ 911 Dispatch Simulator is actively being developed. You may encounter bugs, unfinished features, and balancing changes. Report bugs and send suggestions through our group/server!
